title: Europe went all in on soft power for too long, Belgian defence minister says
content: In an interview with Euronews, the Belgian defence minister argued that Europe spent too long focusing on soft power instead of defence.
snippet: In an interview with Euronews, the Belgian defence minister argued that Europe spent too long focusing on soft power instead of defence.

title: 'Don't care about supporting Russia': Bulgarian PM hits back against pro-Moscow label
content: The Bulgarian prime minister is principal among EU leaders calling for talks with Moscow over its war on Ukraine, earning him a pro-Russia label.

title: WATCH: NATO model 'not sustainable', alliance's chief Mark Rutte tells Euronews
content: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte spoke exclusively to Euronews about the most pressing challenges facing the alliance, including overreliance on the US and Russia's nuclear threat. Watch the interview here.
